tldr: Causal marginal distributions determine Gaussian Bures barycenter summaries even when the coupling of potential outcomes is unrestricted. In the supplied rank-one rare-angle experiment, the minimax absolute risk and the expected length of uniformly ninety-percent honest connected intervals for the exact logarithmic transverse-variance ratio both have order \(p^{-1}\min\{1,(np)^{-1/3}\}\), with no additional logarithmic factor. Uniform additive precision, equivalently multiplicative precision for the transverse covariance ratio, is possible exactly when \(np^4\to\infty\).
